verdict.line: Buy. A 3-bed here at about $2,600 to $2,800 psf is at or below what the closest competitors' 3-bed-size resales support (about $2,820 psf as a new launch). 3-bed and 4-bed are the most wanted sizes in this mixed own-stay and rental area.
reasons: The closest competitors (Piccadilly Grand, Sturdee Residences, Soleil @ Sinaran) work out to about $2,820 psf as a brand-new launch, after adding 5% where they were not built under the harmonised floor-area rules, a 19% new-launch premium (what launches selling now in the RCR charge over their closest resale, 9 launches).

Piccadilly Grand (338 m away, 407 homes, completed 2025): its 3-bed-size resales (about 810 to 1,090 sq ft) averaged $2,450 psf over the last 6 months (3 resales), against a median $2,386 psf for all sizes. A 3-bed here at about $2,701 psf is $251 psf (+10%) above that; a 3-bed there sold for a median $3.18M.

The newest land bid nearby, Peck Hay Road (GLS) (1,360 m, $1,865 psf ppr), is 39% above this site's land cost. It breaks even at about $2,990 psf, and analysts expect it to launch at $3,400-3,900 (PropNex, ERA, CBRE, Knight Frank).
Bought at the tested $2,701 psf, the base case makes about +30% after stamp duty and selling costs by 2032 (5.3% a year); bought at $2,820 psf it makes about +24%.

Who can buy a 3-bed from you (tested at today's $2.57M; about $3.54M by 2032 in the base case): HDB 5-room upgraders yes; HDB 4-room upgraders yes; Landed owners right-sizing yes; Condo owners nearby moving or upgrading yes. Resale pool: wide.

Building, finance, fees and other costs

compsNote: 3 of the 3 competitors are within 1 km. Near-twins come first: up to two condos within 1.5 km with a similar number of homes (half to double) completed in 2016 or later. Then every suitable condo within 1 km (same tenure, completed 2011 or later first), widening to 2 km and 3 km only if fewer than 3; executive condos are left out. Resale prices are URA medians for the last 6 months where there were at least 5 resales, otherwise the last 12 months. Condos launched before June 2023 measured their areas under the old rules (including air-con ledges), so their psf is raised 5% to compare like for like.
priceDecide: Like for like by size: for each unit type we take each resale competitor's average psf for units within about 15% of that size (last 6 months, or 12 or 24 if too few). Each is raised by the 19% new-launch premium that launches selling now in the RCR carry over their closest resale (9 launches). Buy at or below = the average of the competitors' new-launch equivalents for that size; walk away above = 5% more. 2-bed: buy at or below $2,690, walk away above $2,820, this project about $2,729 psf; 3-bed: buy at or below $2,820, walk away above $2,960, this project about $2,701 psf; 4-bed: buy at or below $2,920, walk away above $3,070, this project about $2,678 psf. This project's price by unit type follows how psf changes with size among the competitors (smaller units usually cost more per sq ft).  The developer breaks even at about $2,270 psf (EdgeProp's method); launches since 2023 priced on average 27% above break-even, which points to about $2,890 psf.

gain.timeline: Buy at the launch, targeted for the first half of 2027 (99.co). No completion date is published; we assume TOP around 2030 or 2031. Seller's Stamp Duty applies for 4 years, so we look at a sale in 2032 (5 years).
gain.costs: Potential gain is after Buyer's Stamp Duty at IRAS rates, about $6,000 legal fees and a 2% agent fee plus 9% GST when you sell. Loan interest, property tax, maintenance and rent are not included.

exit.mopNote: HDB 4-room and bigger flats completed from 2021 that reach their 5-year minimum occupation period by about 2032, in the towns resale buyers come from (HDB Property Information, data.gov.sg). New MOP flats add fresh upgraders.
exit.note: How we test each buyer group, in today's money (prices, HDB values and incomes tend to rise together): the unit at today's tested price; a 25% down payment plus Buyer's Stamp Duty; HDB upgraders put their flat's sale proceeds in first (median resale price, minus an illustrative $150,000 loan). The group can buy if that capital covers the down payment and stamp duty; the income the remaining 30-year loan needs (tested at 4% under the 55% TDSR) is shown against SingStat's 2025 averages by home type, excluding employer CPF (4-room $11,097, 5-room and executive $13,887, condo $22,006). HDB resale prices rose 4.2% a year over the past 10 years, so upgraders' capital usually grows too. Singaporean HDB owners who buy before selling pay 20% Additional Buyer's Stamp Duty upfront and get it back only if they sell the flat within 6 months (IRAS).
exit.line: In this mixed own-stay and rental area, the 2-bed resale pool is wide; the 3-bed resale pool is wide; the 4-bed resale pool is good.

fplans.note: Main layout per bedroom type (most units where counts are published), redrawn from the developers' plans in the Stacked Homes directory. Score out of 10, same rules for every plan: start at 4; +1 regular shape, dumbbell, kitchen that can be closed off, kitchen or yard window, AC ledge and planter under 5%, store or shelter or utility room; −1 long corridor, ledge and planter 10% or more, balcony over 12%. Efficiency = the share of the area not taken by AC ledges, planters, bay windows and corridors. Plans under the 2023 rules exclude AC ledges from the strata area, so their sq ft is all usable.
